name: aws_secret
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk AWS Secrets Manager secret.

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this secret (path parameter).

attributes.name: resource_group_id
attributes.description: ID of the resource group this secret belongs to.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: ID of the environment that owns the resource group.

attributes.name: secret_value_type
attributes.description: How the secret value is interpreted: PlainText or Json.

attributes.name: secret_string
attributes.description: The secret value (sensitive). For secret_value_type Json, a JSON-encoded string.

attributes.name: secret_description
attributes.description: Description stored on the AWS secret itself.

attributes.name: kms_key_id
attributes.description: KMS key ID used to encrypt the secret. Defaults to the AWS-managed key when omitted.

attributes.name: provisioner_type
attributes.description: Provisioner type (set by the platform; e.g. DirectApiCall).

attributes.name: arn
attributes.description: ARN of the provisioned AWS Secrets Manager secret.
